gap.note: pools whose bytes could count toward the +1617162 honest-byte gap; excluded_library and svc_region cannot (non-redistributable / not producible from C under neg-svc-stub)
gap.winnable_bytes_note: sum over available pools only; instruction pools are null in offline mode and contribute 0 here, they are counted in full mode

excluded_library.gap_note: cannot close the gap: non-redistributable prebuilt middleware/SDK, excluded from the target by convention

hot_bespoke.gap_note: could close the gap: flagship manual targets (top coverage hits / largest functions), highest per-function effort

lifted.gap_note: could close the gap: a lifted scaffold is not a match; the function can still be honestly matched later

other.gap_note: could close the gap: honest unclassified remainder - an honest large `other` is a result, not a failure

parked_recipe.gap_note: hard: every recipe here is a proven hard skip under current armcc physics; bytes close only via new source physics, not by retrying

sead_named.gap_note: could close the gap: name-known engine code, ordinary matching work (name-based pool, approximate)

shape_family_residue.gap_note: could close the gap: admitting the already byte-verified shape to shared/include unlocks these functions; highest-leverage pool

source_lost.gap_note: could close the gap: re-derivation target (dna twin + synth); bytes count toward honest once matched

svc_region.gap_note: cannot close from C: neg-svc-stub (armcc's __svc is call-shaped; frameless svc stubs are SDK asm) - exclusion candidate, not honestly matchable

setup_hint:
code.bin/capstone not available in this environment; the instruction pools
(svc_region, parked_recipe, shape_family_residue) and the per-function
instruction metadata are null. All ledger pools are still fully classified.
On the box with your own USA dump (code.bin in the repo root, SHA-1
e6ab7d66ee62e879248b0660aaf38d22202e604b, 6,455,296 bytes) and capstone installed (`uv sync`), run:
  uv run python tools/census.py --json          # full census incl. instruction pools (exit 0)
  uv run python tools/census.py --write-full    # full copies under logs/census/
  python tools/census.py --write                 # refresh canonical ledger-pinned outputs
  python tools/census.py check                   # CI freshness check (offline, always works)
